# Malta construction

Used in [Air Game — the Mediterranean bases and Malta](/rules/air/80-mediterranean-and-malta).

## Table

| Die | Levels |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0 |
| 2–5 | 1 |
| 6 | 2 |

## Notes

- Maltese Air Facility Construction Table, 44.5. Read twice, from the archive.org scan (jp2 177, the Axis chart set) and the community chart PDFs (Axis Charts.pdf p. 35): 0 of 6 cells differ.
- One die per Maltese air facility per Game-Turn; levels is how many levels may be repaired or built, up to the facility's standard level, at no supply cost.
